1	import unittest
2	from api import update_preferences
3	
4	
5	class SettingsTests(unittest.TestCase):
6	    def test_updates_note(self):
7	        original = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
8	        result = update_preferences(original, {"note": "after"})
9	        self.assertEqual(result, {"note": "after", "enabled": True})
10	        self.assertEqual(original["note"], "before")
11	
12	    def test_supplied_none_replaces_note(self):
13	        original = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
14	        result = update_preferences(original, {"note": None})
15	        self.assertEqual(result, {"note": None, "enabled": True})
16	
17	    def test_supplied_empty_text_replaces_note(self):
18	        original = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
19	        result = update_preferences(original, {"note": ""})
20	        self.assertEqual(result, {"note": "", "enabled": True})
21	
22	    def test_supplied_false_replaces_enabled(self):
23	        original = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
24	        result = update_preferences(original, {"enabled": False})
25	        self.assertEqual(result, {"note": "before", "enabled": False})
26	
27	    def test_omitted_keys_keep_current_values(self):
28	        original = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
29	        result = update_preferences(original, {})
30	        self.assertEqual(result, {"note": "before", "enabled": True})
